callouts.title: Input layout
callouts.text: PyTorch: a list of CHW float tensors, 0 to 1. Keras: one HWC batch, 0 to 255.

callouts.title: Resizing
callouts.text: torchvision resizes inside the model. With KerasHub we letterbox ourselves, because its converter crops.

callouts.title: Box format and coordinate space
callouts.text: torchvision returns xyxy in original pixels. KerasHub returns yxyx in model-input pixels, so we convert and map back.
